description.value:
Arcs of lightning erupt from your outstretched hands in a 60-foot cone. Each creature within must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 12d6 lightning damage, taking half as much on a success.

Casting this power with a force slot of 8th level or higher increases the damage by 2d6 for each slot level beyond 7th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 7
